english:
Scoring 6 weapon hits within 7 seconds of each against <strand Severed /> enemies applies <strand Unravel />.

Severed enemy Kills release 3 healing pulses at the enemy's death location. Pulses occur every 2 seconds, each restoring 15 HP and granting <strand Woven Mail /> for 10 seconds to you and allies within 10 meters.

source.text:
Upon scoring 6 weapon damage instances within 7 seconds of each against Severed Enemies:
Inflicts Unravel.

On Severed Enemy Kill:
Releases 3 healing pulses on Enemy Death Location,
Pulses restore 15 HP and grant Woven Mail for 10 seconds to the user and allies within 10 metres every 2 seconds.
